answer: A concrete rule the ledger can enforce: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because willow only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, terrace is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any canyon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
